deadline.value: Paid positions are advertised as vacancies with their own deadlines.
deadline.quote: Every year, the Institute of Biology Leiden and the National Herbarium Netherlands have paid positions available for PhD candidates, that are filled on a merit basis.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

funding.value: Paid PhD positions are filled on a merit basis; self-funded entry needs grants covering living costs and a bench fee.
funding.quote: Every year, the Institute of Biology Leiden and the National Herbarium Netherlands have paid positions available for PhD candidates, that are filled on a merit basis.

entry_route.value: An MSc degree is required for admission to the PhD programme.
entry_route.quote: An MSc degree is required for admission to the PhD programme.
